events.summary: Unable to reform the Church of Avacyn, the order is founded to battle evil.

events.summary: En route to free Thraben, the Order acquires Avacyn's spear and joins an alliance with Sigarda and Olivia Voldaren's vampires.

events.summary: Many of the order become possessed by geists of former cathars to resist Emrakul's corruption.
events.quote: Many of the order did choose to become possessed by geists of former cathars

relations.quote: Prominent members include Odric , Grete , and Rem Karolus .
